text:
The electronic structure of element Z is 2,8,1.
Which statements about Z are correct?
1
It is a metal.
2
It has two outer-shell electrons.
3
It is in Period 3.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 only
subject: Chemistry
